title: Session State
description: Schema for session/session_state.json — persisted state across all plugin commands.

platform.description: Set by G1 — absolute first gate

is_shared_data_product.description: True if target database uses a shared_ prefix (shared_fdp_, shared_cdp_, shared_bdp_). Set by G1.5 auto-resolution. When true, data_product_type still resolves to the parent type (FDP/CDP/BDP) and all routing remains identical.

tenancy_name.description: Feature Team Name from tenancy skill (Glue: Hive/Iceberg Database columns) or databricks-tenancy skill (Databricks: Target DB column) — resolved by looking up target_database

tenancy_resolution_method.description: How infrastructure values were obtained: 'registry' (from tenancy registry lookup) or 'user_provided' (from interactive questionnaire). Used by assertions to conditionally check questionnaire_turns_completed.

python_path.description: Resolved Python executable path (e.g. 'python', '/c/devhome/tools/python3.12/current/python'). Set during /de-init step 7. Used by /de-gen-tests and validators that invoke Python. Null if Python not found.

python_version.description: Detected Python version string (e.g. '3.12.7'). Set during /de-init step 7. Null if Python not found.

syntax_check_result.description: Result of py_compile syntax check on generated .py artefacts. Set after each generation command completes. Null if not yet run. The /push gate blocks on null or skipped_no_python unless --skip-syntax-check is explicitly provided.

syntax_check_failures.description: List of file paths that failed py_compile. Null if syntax check passed or was skipped.

test_execution_result.description: Result of optional pytest execution. Set by /de-gen-tests STEP 6 or /de-run-tests. Null if not yet run.

test_execution_output.description: First 50 lines of pytest stdout/stderr when test_execution_result is 'failed'. Null otherwise.

source_volumetrics_path.description: Path to session/source_volumetrics.json — parsed volumetric data from 'Source Volumetrics' sheet. Null if sheet not present in mapping Excel. Consumed by transform-generator-agent (broadcast/repartition), glue-dtxog-agent (worker sizing), and databricks-artefact-agent (cluster sizing).

domain_knowledge_text.description: Full text of Domain Knowledge .md file. Null if not supplied.

domain_knowledge_validated_tenancy.description: Tenancy name extracted from domain knowledge file header marker (**Tenancy**: `{name}`) during STEP 2.5 validation. Null if no domain knowledge loaded or no marker found. Used by downstream agents to verify tenancy alignment before applying domain knowledge signals.

data_flow_detection.description: Multi-source-system detection and artifact mode. Populated by /gen-config STEP 0.5 when multiple data flows are detected. Read by downstream commands (/gen-transform, /gen-wrapper, /gen-dag, etc.) to determine per-source-system artifact generation strategy.

resolved_mode.description: Detected data flow mode from 3-way priority (user override → domain knowledge → mapping structure → default)

resolved_by.description: Which detection priority resolved the data flow mode

artifact_mode.description: Artifact generation strategy: 'default' (single-flow or per-source-system when source_systems is non-empty), 'combined' (single artifact with UNION logic)

source_systems.description: List of source_system labels (e.g., ['ilp', 'reference_data']). Populated when resolved_mode is 'multiple_data_flow'. When non-empty, commands loop per source_system to generate independent artifacts.

source_system_table_mapping.description: Maps each source_system label to its source tables (FQN). Built from mapping_parsed.json source_system_hint. Example: {"ilp": ["e_cms_db.cmrcase"], "reference_data": ["ref_common_db.region_lookup"]}

union_detected.description: True when mapping Business Logic contains 'Union Branch N:' structured format or union_metadata is present

source_catalog.description: Databricks-only. Unity Catalog name for source tables (e.g. 'BUK_BASE_GLUE_CATALOG'). Resolved from domain knowledge or user input. Null for Glue platform.

foundation_library_version.description: Databricks-only. Version of databricks_foundation library to install in job clusters. Default '0.1.5'. Null for Glue platform.

spark_version.description: Databricks-only. Databricks Runtime version for job clusters. Default '16.4.x-scala2.12'. Null for Glue platform.

foundation_library_url.description: Databricks-only. Full Nexus URL for the databricks_foundation wheel package. Default points to version 0.1.5. Null for Glue platform.

bundle_generated.description: Databricks-only. True if /de-gen-bundle has completed successfully. Null for Glue platform.

gates_resolved.description: List of gates that have been resolved. Note: G1.5 is auto-resolved (implicit) during /de-parse-mapping based on target database prefix; it does not require user interaction.

open_placeholders.description: List of placeholder names currently unresolved

artefact_status.description: Map of artefact relative path (from project root, e.g. 'generated/glue/mesh/fdp_uk_mortgage_db_account_wm_mesh.json') to status: GENERATED, VALIDATED, DRAFT_UNVALIDATED. All artefacts use {db}_{table} naming under generated/{platform}/{artefact_type}/.

is_crypto.description: True if transformation logic contains explicit crypto signal

operation.description: tokenize (protect), detokenize (unprotect), or null if no crypto

de_name.description: Protegrity Data Element name. Must match pattern: (UK|US|APAC)_TOK_<func>_L<d>R<d>_<type>_DE

extraction_failed.description: True if DE name not extractable or validation failed. Triggers refusal.

extraction_ambiguous.description: True when both 'tokenize' and 'detokenize' keywords found

env_config.description: Centralized per-environment infrastructure values. Resolved ONCE during /de-parse-mapping STEP 2.6. All downstream agents consume from here — never independently derive per-env values.

tenancy_name.description: Feature team tenancy name from Tenancy Registry (e.g., 'fdpmortgage')

catalog_type.description: Catalog type determines env_prefix pattern: iceberg → dev1/uat1/prd1; hive → dev/uat/prd

bucket_shortname.description: S3 bucket shortname from Tenancy Registry (e.g., 'fdpmortgage01')

account_type.description: Account type: FDP/CDP → DDA; BDP → BCA

s3_bucket.description: Full S3 bucket name for dev (Pattern 1 or 2)

compid.description: Netcool compid (null for dev/uat, set for prd)

crypto_account_id.description: AWS account ID for crypto bucket (Pattern 4)

crypto_itsi.description: ITSI code for crypto operations in dev

crypto_api_endpoint_url.description: Crypto API endpoint URL for dev

s3_bucket.description: Full S3 bucket name for uat (Pattern 1 or 2)

compid.description: Netcool compid (null for dev/uat, set for prd)

crypto_account_id.description: AWS account ID for crypto bucket (Pattern 4)

crypto_itsi.description: ITSI code for crypto operations in uat

crypto_api_endpoint_url.description: Crypto API endpoint URL for uat

s3_bucket.description: Full S3 bucket name for prd (Pattern 1 or 2)

compid.description: Netcool compid for prd (required for production alerting)

crypto_account_id.description: AWS account ID for crypto bucket (Pattern 4)

crypto_itsi.description: ITSI code for crypto operations in prd

crypto_api_endpoint_url.description: Crypto API endpoint URL for prd

questionnaire_turns_completed.description: Number of questionnaire questions completed (6 = full Glue questionnaire). Null if tenancy resolved from registry (no questionnaire needed). Used by POST-RESOLUTION ASSERTIONs to detect incomplete questionnaire runs.

dbx_config.description: Centralized Databricks infrastructure values. Resolved ONCE during /parse-mapping STEP 2.7 (from databricks-tenancy registry or interactive infrastructure questionnaire). All downstream agents consume from here — never independently derive values.

target_catalog.description: Unity Catalog write/target catalog for dev (e.g., dev_buk_pafer_bdp)

workspace_folder.description: Databricks workspace folder for dev (e.g., DEV_BUK_PAFER_BDP)

cicd_sp.description: CICD service principal for dev (e.g., buk_pafer_bdp_cicd_dev_sp)

exec_sp.description: Exec service principal for dev (e.g., buk_pafer_bdp_exec_dev_sp)

ad_group.description: Azure AD security group(s) for dev

app_service_tag.description: ITSI code for dev env (e.g., SNSVC0081840). Per-env — may differ from preprd/prd.

fin_role_tag.description: FIN:Role composite tag for dev env (e.g., SNSVC0081840_EDPUC-1597_BUK_BBKYC_BDP). Per-env.

target_catalog.description: Unity Catalog write/target catalog for preprd

ad_group.description: Azure AD security group(s) for preprd

app_service_tag.description: ITSI code for preprd env. Per-env — may differ from dev/prd.

fin_role_tag.description: FIN:Role composite tag for preprd env. Per-env.

target_catalog.description: Unity Catalog write/target catalog for prd

ad_group.description: Azure AD security group(s) for prd

app_service_tag.description: ITSI code for prd env. Per-env — may differ from dev/preprd.

fin_role_tag.description: FIN:Role composite tag for prd env. Per-env.

notification_email.description: Email for job success/failure notifications. Default: BUKDataPlatformDatabricks@barclays.com

tenancy_name.description: Feature team tenancy name. Written by infrastructure questionnaire Turn 1 or registry lookup.

questionnaire_turns_completed.description: Number of questionnaire turns completed (5 = full Databricks questionnaire). Null if tenancy resolved from registry (no questionnaire needed). Used by POST-RESOLUTION ASSERTIONs to detect incomplete questionnaire runs.

mesh_json_s3_locations.description: G3 answers — per-environment S3 locations for Mesh JSON. Auto-populated from env_config during STEP 2.6. Glue only.

target_tables.description: Multi-table support: Array of unique target tables found in mapping. Set during /de-parse-mapping.

intent_resolved.description: True if all 6 intent fields resolved for this table

row_count_in_mapping.description: Number of rows in mapping Excel targeting this table

structured_logic_detected.description: True if any row for this table uses structured transformation format (Driver Table: ... pattern)

optional_mapping_columns.description: DEPRECATED — columns 13-16 are now required. Retained for backward compatibility with existing session state files. Always contains all 4 columns when populated: ['Transformation Type', 'Key Column', 'Target Table Type', 'Default Value'].

parse_warnings.description: Accumulated parse-time advisory signals. Set during /de-parse-mapping Phase 3c post-check. Non-blocking — pipeline continues regardless. Consumed by intent-identifier-agent (advisory message) and de-validate (quality reporting).

type.description: Advisory category — none of these block generation

column.description: Target column name that triggered the warning

source_tables_referenced.description: List of distinct source tables referenced by this column (for join_logic_missing)

structured_logic_detected.description: True if any row in the mapping uses structured transformation format. Set during /de-parse-mapping STEP 2.7.

total_target_tables.description: Count of unique target tables. Set during /de-parse-mapping.

pending_intent_tables.description: List of tables awaiting intent clarification via G5-grain gate

batch_size.description: Number of tables per batch in parallel execution (Phase B2). Default: 3. Can be overridden per session.

table_status.description: Per-table generation status tracking (Phase B2). Enables resumability for partial batch completion. Maps table_name → status object.

mesh_generated.description: True if mesh JSON generated for this table

transform_generated.description: True if transform (day0/day1 or single) generated for this table

wrapper_generated.description: True if wrapper.py generated for this table (Glue only)

config_generated.description: True if config.json generated for this table (Glue only). Must be paired with wrapper_generated.

dtxog_generated.description: True if dtxog config generated for this table (Glue only)

ddl_generated.description: True if Iceberg DDL generated for this table (Databricks only)

driver_generated.description: True if driver.py generated for this table (Databricks only)

dag_generated.description: True if Airflow DAG file generated for this table

last_batch_index.description: Index of batch where this table was last processed (for resumability)

generation_time_ms.description: Time taken to generate all artefacts for this table (milliseconds)

compute_tier_day0.description: Assigned compute tier for Day0 job based on source volumetrics (estimated_size_gb). Null if volumetrics unavailable (defaults to medium at generation time). Databricks only.

compute_tier_day1.description: Assigned compute tier for Day1 job based on source volumetrics (daily_increment_size_gb). Null if volumetrics unavailable (defaults to medium at generation time). Databricks only.

phases.description: Resume tracking: status of each command phase. Commands check this before running.

cached_result.description: Cached result from this phase for resume (can be any JSON type)

agent_status.description: Tracks completion status of each agent invocation in the pipeline.

code_review.description: Status of code-review-agent. Set by /de-review command.

auto_chain.description: Auto-chain execution state. Present only in full-automation mode. Tracks halt state for /de-resume recovery.

halted_at_step.description: Step number where chain halted (1-indexed). Null if not halted.

halted_at_command.description: Command name where chain halted (e.g. '/de-identify-intent'). Null if not halted.

halt_reason.description: Human-readable halt reason (e.g. 'G5-grain: primary_key_columns UNRESOLVED for fdp_uk_mortgage_db.account_wm')

completed_steps.description: Array of step numbers that completed successfully before halt

report_generated.description: Path to intent resolution report (e.g. 'session/intent_resolution_report.md'). Null if no report.

chain_mode.description: When true, commands suppress verbose conversation output (session state echoes, per-file progress) and emit only compact 4-line summaries. Verbose details written to session/audit_log.jsonl instead. Automatically set to true when auto_chain.enabled == true.

chain_checkpoints.description: Context checkpoints written at phase boundaries during auto-chain execution. Downstream commands read relevant checkpoints for reliable compact context (~200-500 tokens) that survives conversation compaction.

post_parse.description: Written after /de-parse-mapping completes. Contains: tenancy, dp_type, target_tables[], target_database, optional_columns[], source_tables_count, crypto_detected, timestamp.

source_volumetrics_available.description: True if Source Volumetrics sheet was present and parsed successfully

post_classification.description: Written after /de-classify-sources completes. Contains: source_table_types map, classification counts by source.

post_intent.description: Written after /de-identify-intent completes. Contains: per-table intent summary, all_resolved flag, auto_decisions_count.

post_config.description: Written after /de-gen-config completes. Contains: generated config paths, filter manifest paths, per-table filter counts. Must exist before /de-gen-transform runs.

config_files.description: Paths to generated config.yml (Databricks) or config.json (Glue) files

alias_specific_filters.description: Count of alias-specific (business) filter entries beyond defaults

post_transform.description: Written after /de-gen-transform completes. Contains: per-table transform status, generated file paths, platform. Used by gen-driver, gen-ddl, gen-bundle for table metadata without re-parsing full session files. Enables mid-phase checkpoint loading on resume.

post_dag.description: Written after /gen-dag completes. Contains: dag_count, schedule_type, platform, tables_with_dags, timestamp. Used by /validate Batch 7 and Phase C agent for DAG validation context.

tables_with_dags.description: List of table names that had DAGs generated

post_generation.description: Written after all generation commands complete. Contains: generated file paths, crypto columns applied, template versions, artefact count.

intent_overrides_applied.description: True if session/intent_overrides.json was loaded and applied during /de-identify-intent or /de-resume

source_table_metadata.description: Source table type classification results. Set by /de-classify-sources. Pipeline halts only if classification cannot be determined from any source (volumetrics, domain knowledge, or mapping document).

status.description: completed = all source tables classified; failed = classification could not be determined for one or more tables (pipeline halts)

unknown_count.description: Sources that triggered HALT for user clarification (0 after successful /de-classify-sources completion)

fallback_count.description: Sources classified via domain knowledge or mapping document heuristics (not via source volumetrics)

contract_reconciliation_result.description: Result of contract reconciliation check across wrapper, transform, config, and generic components. Set by /gen-wrapper STEP FINAL.1 or /validate Batch 4. Null if not yet run.

contract_reconciliation_violations.description: Array of contract violation objects if result is 'failed'. Null otherwise.

contract_reconciliation_retries.description: Number of self-heal retries attempted during /gen-wrapper STEP FINAL.1 (0, 1, or 2). Null if not yet run.
